label: GOD_4 HAS_INTELLECT_1 from a PURE_ACT_5 root's self-knowledge and finite reach (inference)
rule: Identify each GOD_4 with the pure-act actual root by finite grounding reach, apply root self-knowledge, then the recognition bridge
meaning: Some n is an actual concrete root at w, necessary, first and in potency in no respect. Take any g that is GOD_4. Finite grounding reach makes g a grounding ancestor of the actual concretum n, and since n has no actual concrete ground the path is trivial, so g = n (namedRootOfReach). The root-level premise gives n intrinsic self-knowledge, and the recognition bridge gives g HAS_INTELLECT_1. The q.14 immateriality premise of the existing intellect routes is not used. The main theorem uses no axioms. The Comparator companion stepTwoControls (propext, Quot.sound; same carrier) gives a positive witness and, for each of the four premises, an assignment where it fails, the three others hold and GOD_4 HAS_INTELLECT_1 fails: the root in potency (root self-knowledge then holds vacuously), GOD_4 naming the effect, which is no ancestor of the root, the root without self-knowledge, and self-knowledge without the HasIntellect predicate.
